notes.title: Major update
notes.content:
According to the player's suggestion, we have made a significant revision to the version;
1: The light and shadow of the game have been revised. In the new version, the stability of the light and shadow has been enhanced, while the saturation has been appropriately reduced and some AO details have been corrected.
2: The operating feel of the character has been greatly optimized and adjusted, and the character operation in the new version is more smooth and natural.
3: Two new DLCs have been added! You can start the game directly after the update.
4: Fixed multiple scenes and game bugs.
